messages:
alex: Quick ping — p95 on CAPI /v1/generate jumped after we shifted ~30% traffic to regional-fallback. p50 looks stable but p95/p99 spiked. Dashboard shows p50 ~120ms, p95 ~1.4s, p99 ~2.8s. Anyone seen this kind of post-routing-change tail before?

maya: Did the routing change also flip quota tiering or move clients into a different capacity pool? if so queueing could explain longer tails.

chen: I pulled logs for the fallback nodes. batch sizes dropped (avg batch 3 -> 1.6) and there's an auth proxy hop adding ~120-160ms for a subset of requests. query I ran:
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) as p95, count(*) as cnt
FROM requests
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND variant='regional-fallback' AND ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'
```
result: p95 ~1400, cnt ~120 in 15m, but 8 requests >2s.

jordan: UX note — console p95 is computed from sampled rollups (10s windows). with low sample counts the p95 can swing a lot. can we show sample count on the chart? right now ppl see numbers without provenance.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled regional-fallback at 1718808600 — weight set 30% -> regional-fallback.

sam: +1 on sample counts. also could be KV cache miss rate spike on that variant. check header `x-kvcache-hit`. if misses increased, we'd see more model compute and longer tails.

maya: Confirmed: quota config unchanged. but the fallback nodes are in a lower-tier cluster with different batching behavior. that cluster also has smaller token budget per request (so longer time for long sequences).

chen: digging more: `curl` traces show auth proxy occasionally timing out and retrying once before forwarding (~200-300ms extra on those requests). so two contributors: smaller batches + proxy jitter + some KV miss.

jordan: From a console design POV we should: (1) display sample counts and which aggregation origin (client vs server vs proxy) (2) annotate deploy/routing changes on the chart timeline (deploy-bot events) (3) surface per-variant batch-size distribution and cache-hit ratio as linked metrics.

alex: Action items: chen — confirm batch-size distribution and extract top 20 slow request traces by route (due EOD). maya — verify cluster capacity and see if we can increase batch window for fallback nodes. jordan — quick UX patch to show sample counts + deploy annotation on the p95 chart (small frontend change). sam — add a telemetry hook to emit `x-kvcache-hit` rollups per-variant if not already emitted. i'll follow up with infra about auth proxy retries.

maya: also a product question: should routing policy consider tail latency explicitly when computing fallback weights? current policy only uses p50 and CPU headroom. maybe add p95 penalty term so we don't shift latency-sensitive traffic into small-batch pools.

sam: Agreed. prefer adding a p95-aware soft constraint. we can prototype in the simulator.

alex: Sounds good. we'll triage as: short fixes (console sample counts, deploy annotations) + medium (telemetry hook, batch window tweak) + longer (routing policy change). tagging for follow-up planning. :thumbsup:
